components.name: Discount
components.requirement: Return the payable minor-unit amount after a 0..10000 basis-point discount, rounding the payable amount down; invalid inputs return -1.
components.source: docs/POLICIES.md#pilot-policy-decisions (Discount; authored pilot default, not independently human-certified)
components.postcondition: if price < 0 || bps < 0 || bps > 10000 then r == -1 else r == (price * (10000 - bps) / 10000)

components.name: AddTax
components.requirement: Return nonnegative price plus tax at 0..10000 basis points, rounding the added tax up; invalid inputs return -1.
components.source: docs/POLICIES.md#pilot-policy-decisions (AddTax; authored pilot default, not independently human-certified)
components.postcondition: if price < 0 || bps < 0 || bps > 10000 then r == -1 else r == (price + (price * bps + 9999) / 10000)

components.name: Prorate
components.requirement: For nonnegative amount, positive total and 0 <= used <= total, return the proportional amount rounded down; invalid inputs return -1.
components.source: docs/POLICIES.md#pilot-policy-decisions (Prorate; authored pilot default, not independently human-certified)
components.postcondition: if amount < 0 || used < 0 || total <= 0 || used > total then r == -1 else r == (amount * used / total)

components.name: CeilDiv
components.requirement: Return the count of positive-size units required to cover a nonnegative amount, rounding up; invalid inputs return -1.
components.source: docs/POLICIES.md#pilot-policy-decisions (CeilDiv; authored pilot default, not independently human-certified)
components.postcondition: if amount < 0 || size <= 0 then r == -1 else r == ((amount + size - 1) / size)

components.name: Clamp
components.requirement: Clamp any integer value to inclusive nonnegative bounds; reject lower < 0 or upper < lower with -1.
components.source: docs/POLICIES.md#pilot-policy-decisions (Clamp; authored pilot default, not independently human-certified)
components.postcondition: if lower < 0 || upper < lower then r == -1 else r == (if value < lower then lower else if value > upper then upper else value)

components.name: SaturatingSub
components.requirement: For nonnegative balance and debit, subtract debit with a floor at zero; invalid inputs return -1.
components.source: docs/POLICIES.md#pilot-policy-decisions (SaturatingSub; authored pilot default, not independently human-certified)
components.postcondition: if balance < 0 || debit < 0 then r == -1 else r == (if debit > balance then 0 else balance - debit)

components.name: TransferRemaining
components.requirement: Return nonnegative balance remaining after a nonnegative affordable transfer; invalid or insufficient funds return -1.
components.source: docs/POLICIES.md#pilot-policy-decisions (TransferRemaining; authored pilot default, not independently human-certified)
components.postcondition: if balance < 0 || amount < 0 || amount > balance then r == -1 else r == (balance - amount)

components.name: ShippingFee
components.requirement: For nonnegative values, charge fee below subtotal threshold and zero at or above threshold; invalid inputs return -1.
components.source: docs/POLICIES.md#pilot-policy-decisions (ShippingFee; authored pilot default, not independently human-certified)
components.postcondition: if subtotal < 0 || threshold < 0 || fee < 0 then r == -1 else r == (if subtotal >= threshold then 0 else fee)

components.name: LoyaltyPoints
components.requirement: For nonnegative spend and positive unit, return whole points units rounded down; invalid inputs return -1.
components.source: docs/POLICIES.md#pilot-policy-decisions (LoyaltyPoints; authored pilot default, not independently human-certified)
components.postcondition: if spend < 0 || unit <= 0 then r == -1 else r == (spend / unit)

components.name: TierRate
components.requirement: For nonnegative values, select low below threshold and high at or above threshold; the rates need not be ordered; invalid inputs return -1.
components.source: docs/POLICIES.md#pilot-policy-decisions (TierRate; authored pilot default, not independently human-certified)
components.postcondition: if quantity < 0 || threshold < 0 || low < 0 || high < 0 then r == -1 else r == (if quantity >= threshold then high else low)

components.name: LateFee
components.requirement: For nonnegative values, charge days beyond grace times rate, limited to cap; invalid inputs return -1.
components.source: docs/POLICIES.md#pilot-policy-decisions (LateFee; authored pilot default, not independently human-certified)
components.postcondition: if days < 0 || grace < 0 || rate < 0 || cap < 0 then r == -1 else r == (if days <= grace then 0 else if (days - grace) * rate > cap then cap else (days - grace) * rate)

components.name: RefundCap
components.requirement: For nonnegative requested and paid amounts, return the smaller amount; invalid inputs return -1.
components.source: docs/POLICIES.md#pilot-policy-decisions (RefundCap; authored pilot default, not independently human-certified)
components.postcondition: if requested < 0 || paid < 0 then r == -1 else r == (if requested <= paid then requested else paid)

components.name: InventoryAvailable
components.requirement: Return nonnegative stock less reservations when reservations do not exceed stock; invalid inputs or overreservation return -1.
components.source: docs/POLICIES.md#pilot-policy-decisions (InventoryAvailable; authored pilot default, not independently human-certified)
components.postcondition: if stock < 0 || reserved < 0 || reserved > stock then r == -1 else r == (stock - reserved)

components.name: ReorderQuantity
components.requirement: For nonnegative quantities, return the shortfall to target or zero if target is met; invalid inputs return -1.
components.source: docs/POLICIES.md#pilot-policy-decisions (ReorderQuantity; authored pilot default, not independently human-certified)
components.postcondition: if available < 0 || target < 0 then r == -1 else r == (if available >= target then 0 else target - available)

components.name: IntervalOverlap
components.requirement: For half-open intervals with nonnegative ordered endpoints, return overlap length; empty or touching intervals have zero overlap; invalid inputs return -1.
components.source: docs/POLICIES.md#pilot-policy-decisions (IntervalOverlap; authored pilot default, not independently human-certified)
components.postcondition: if a_start < 0 || a_end < a_start || b_start < 0 || b_end < b_start then r == -1 else r == (if (if a_end <= b_end then a_end else b_end) <= (if a_start >= b_start then a_start else b_start) then 0 else (if a_end <= b_end then a_end else b_end) - (if a_start >= b_start then a_start else b_start))

components.name: WithinWindow
components.requirement: For a nonnegative ordered half-open window, return 1 exactly when any-integer value is at least start and less than end, otherwise 0; invalid window returns -1.
components.source: docs/POLICIES.md#pilot-policy-decisions (WithinWindow; authored pilot default, not independently human-certified)
components.postcondition: if start < 0 || end < start then r == -1 else r == (if start <= value && value < end then 1 else 0)

components.name: LeapYear
components.requirement: For a positive year, return 1 for a proleptic Gregorian leap year and 0 otherwise; invalid inputs return -1.
components.source: docs/POLICIES.md#pilot-policy-decisions (LeapYear; authored pilot default, not independently human-certified)
components.postcondition: if year <= 0 then r == -1 else r == (if (year % 400 == 0 || (year % 4 == 0 && year % 100 != 0)) then 1 else 0)

components.name: DaysInMonth
components.requirement: Return proleptic Gregorian month length for positive year and month 1..12; invalid inputs return -1.
components.source: docs/POLICIES.md#pilot-policy-decisions (DaysInMonth; authored pilot default, not independently human-certified)
components.postcondition: if year <= 0 || month < 1 || month > 12 then r == -1 else r == (if month == 2 then (if (year % 400 == 0 || (year % 4 == 0 && year % 100 != 0)) then 29 else 28) else if month == 4 || month == 6 || month == 9 || month == 11 then 30 else 31)

components.name: MaxOfThree
components.requirement: Return the maximum of three nonnegative integers, allowing equality; invalid inputs return -1.
components.source: docs/POLICIES.md#pilot-policy-decisions (MaxOfThree; authored pilot default, not independently human-certified)
components.postcondition: if a < 0 || b < 0 || c < 0 then r == -1 else r == (if a >= b && a >= c then a else if b >= c then b else c)

components.name: MedianOfThree
components.requirement: Return the middle order statistic of three nonnegative integers, preserving duplicate values; invalid inputs return -1.
components.source: docs/POLICIES.md#pilot-policy-decisions (MedianOfThree; authored pilot default, not independently human-certified)
components.postcondition: if a < 0 || b < 0 || c < 0 then r == -1 else r == (if (a <= b && b <= c) || (c <= b && b <= a) then b else if (b <= a && a <= c) || (c <= a && a <= b) then a else c)
